hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then echo 'No package-lock.json yet: run npm install --ignore-scripts once.'; exit 0; fi; if ! bash .github/kit-identity.sh >&2; then echo 'kit-identity failed: nothing was installed. Do not run npm ci. Tell the owner.'; exit 0; fi; sum=$(node -p "require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('node:fs').readFileSync('package-lock.json')).digest('hex')") || exit 1; if [ "$sum" != "$(cat node_modules/.kit-stamp 2>/dev/null)" ]; then npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund >&2 || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$sum" > node_modules/.kit-stamp; fi; cat node_modules/@raess/astro-kit/docs/INDEX.md
